meta.description: Style LoRA on FLUX.2 Klein 4B (gated on HF). Network 64/32 linear + 32/16 Conv2d (ratio 4:2:2:1) — a HALF-scale fold of the 128/64/64/32 style recipe that Black Forest Labs' own Klein style training example uses (and that LDS and the Calvin Herbst 64-run sweep both ship). Reviewed 2026-09-11: the halving is now a DELIBERATE FORK DEVIATION from the model author's published numbers — 128 judged too heavy for a 4B — not a guess made in the absence of a source. The 9B style preset was raised to the official 128/64/64/32. BFL's example also runs LR 9.5e-5 / weight decay 1.5e-4 / 3000 steps against the 1e-4 / 2500 here; a 50+-run community sweep independently found style runs preferring weight decay 1e-5, so LR and decay are the knobs to try before rank. Alpha = rank/2 (same as LDS). Weighted timesteps = Klein arch canonical. Content-only captions, no trigger. Steps: LDS computes 50/image clamped [1200,3000]. For the 9B: arch flux2_klein_9b + the -9B path. If you want to reproduce LDS exactly, set linear 128 / alpha 64 / conv 64 / conv_alpha 32. Speed (2026-08-29): latents are served from RAM after the first pass (cache_latents + cache_latents_to_disk — disk-only caching re-read every latent every step), loss_sync_every 4, ui_db_poll_seconds 2. Training math unchanged.
